prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the floor inside a giant hollow tree: living wood seen from above with wavy concentric growth-ring grain, knots, shallow cracks, warm brown. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a SQUARE seamless tileable game texture, edge-to-edge ground surface only. Top-down orthographic JRPG map floor inside a giant hollow living tree, warm brown wood seen from directly above: broad wavy concentric growth-ring grain meandering across the whole tile, small knots and occasional shallow cracks evenly distributed, no focal element. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel-art RPG texture, intentionally hand-placed clean pixel clusters, crisp uniformly sized square art pixels, no antialiasing, no blur, no soft brushwork, no photographic texture, no random noise, no checkerboard dithering. Rich earthy controlled palette with 4–6 shades per material: saturated purple-red brown in crevices and shadows, medium caramel brown, warm yellow-brown highlights. Ring lines should be organic yet pixel-stepped, coherent and broad, with shaped clusters of 3–10 art pixels. Soft even neutral upper-left ambient illumination, base daytime color texture only; no cast shadows, no glow, no localized lighting, no vignette. Strict seamless repeat: exact visual continuity of growth rings, colors, and cracks across left/right edges and top/bottom edges. Fill the square, no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text.
